name: Busa Launch
description: Product-launch command desk built on the RAMP discipline

agentPrompts.label: What's my launch readiness right now?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-launch` skill in this folder, then report the Launch Quality Score and overall verdict (SHIP/FIX/BLOCK), the countdown to the target date, RAMP phase progress, and channel-submission status.

agentPrompts.label: Assemble my launch from product docs
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-launch` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then read the product docs, positioning notes, and target date I give you, write the RAMP checklist with per-item readiness and drafts, and give me the AirApp URL to review it.

agentPrompts.label: Execute what I've approved
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-launch` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then re-read the approved items, mark them done, and perform the actual submissions or sends only through the corresponding skill, one item at a time. Never submit or send an item without an explicit approve decision, never re-submit an item already done, and do not proceed if the readiness gate is BLOCK.
